marc:datafield.marc:subfield: Metabolic syndrome: -Metabolic syndrome defines a clustering of major cardiovascular risk factors along with abdominal obesity -It is associated with conditions such as raised blood pressure, low HDL cholesterol, raised triglycerides and glucose intolerance -The root cause of metabolic syndrome is thought to be insulin resistance -This presentation provides information on metabolic syndrome and its constituent conditions-diabetes, insulin resistance, hypertension and dyslipidemia, with a note on the risk factors and management of the condition
